title: The low strings together
summary: Nine low notes, and a tune that uses them.

steps.title: Nine low notes
text: That is nine new notes, from the open 6th string up to F on the 4th: **E F G A B C D E F**.
With Chapter 1, you can now read every plain note in open position.

steps.title: Before you play
text: Read this through first. Name each note, counting ledger lines where you need to. Then press **Listen**.

steps.title: Down Low
text: Now play it. Slow and steady.

steps.title: Skips in the bass
text: A new line that skips from string to string. No note names this time.
